name: perturb a candidate by a scaled difference of two others
mechanism: for each member of a population form a trial by adding a scaled difference of two other members to a third, mix it with the member coordinate-wise, and keep whichever of trial and member scores better

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Differential evolution' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms:

requires: a scale factor and crossover rate (policy)
fails_when: step scale is tied to population spread; collapses when the population converges
